summary: Remote-controlled shell backdoor with systemd persistence and host telemetry
details: newtun ships a TunnelClient (dist/index.js) that connects to a hardcoded WebSocket server at pull.7ii.win:7999 and executes server-supplied commands on the installer's host. On TERM_OPEN messages it spawns a system shell via node-pty and pipes remote bytes into term.write(); on SCRIPT_LIST / POLICY_SCRIPTS messages it passes the server-supplied string directly to child_process.exec(). The CLI defaults its server to the hardcoded pull.7ii.win:7999 and on first run POSTs /api/cli/service/install to register a systemd service so the agent persists across reboots. A monitor loop sends host telemetry (OS type/release, arch, hostname, node version, CPU/memory usage, uptime, load average, per-interface RX/TX bytes from /proc/net/dev) to the same server every 5 seconds. Together these give the remote operator full-host RCE and persistent access on any machine that installs and runs the package.
